BETWEEN:-
 BHANUDATT TIWARI S/O LATE SHRI HARINARAYAN  TIWARI, AGED ABOUT 33 YEARS, OCCUPATION:
UNEMPLOYED R/O VILLAGE VIVEKANAND NAGAR LIG

1 1 8 P.S. KOTWALI DISTRICT DAMOH (MADHYA  PRADESH).
 
 (SHRI S.M. GURU - ADVOCATE FOR APPLICANT)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION KOTWALI, DISTRICT DAMOH (MADHYA  PRADESH).
 
 (SHRI AKSHAY NAMDEO - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE FOR STATE AND  SHRI R.B. PATEL - ADVOCATE FOR OBJECTOR)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the s e c o n d b a i l application filed on behalf of the applicant/accused under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Crime No. 733/2023, registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Damoh (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 377, 506,
498-A read with Section 34 of IPC.
2 .

Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that there is exception (2) to Section 375 of IPC, which lays down that nothing is rape between husband and wife if age of wife is above 18 years.
It is submitted that Section 375 has been amended and anal intercourse has now also been included as rape.
Voluntary anal intercourse between the parties is covered under Section 377 of IPC.
Case of applicant will not be covered under Section 377 of IPC because act was not voluntary.

sentences.text: Complainant was opposing it.

Since complainant was opposing it therefore, it will fall within definition of rape, but, applicant will be covered under exception (2) of Section 375 of IPC and therefore, no offence either under Section 375 read with Section 376 or under Section 377 of IPC is made out against the applicant.
In these circumstances, applicant may be granted anticipatory bail.
3. Counsel appearing for the objector opposed the said prayer and submitted that woman has a choice to express herself.
Said choice has been guaranteed to her in Constitution of India and she has a fundamental right to deny to have physical relationship with any person.
Even if husband does sexual intercourse with wife without her permission, then same will amount to rape and applicant will not be covered under exception.
4. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for State opposed the application for grant of anticipatory bail.
5. Heard the learned counsel for the parties 6.
This Court is considering bail application of applicant.

Exception (2) to Section 375 of IPC is not under consideration before this Court, neither any petition or prayer has been made by counsel for objector or Government Advocate regarding the same or attacking said exception in this case.
7.Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant in connection with the aforesaid crime number and the offences, he be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Authority.
8. The applicant is directed to join the investigation immediately and to co-operate with the investigating agency.

He will further abide by the condition enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.
9.
Certified copy as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE vkt Bhanudatt Tiwari vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183180455/
